what: PostToolUse registration still matches Read only
scenario_or_breakage: Plan adds a Bash branch to hook-anti-read-poll.sh as the primary #3175 fix, but hooks.json only registers that script under matcher Read. Claude Code will not invoke the hook after Bash tool calls, so production cat/tail/head of tasks/*.output keeps slipping through while test-hook-anti-read-poll.sh passes because it pipes Bash JSON directly into the script.
suggested_fix: Register Bash on the same PostToolUse entry (e.g. matcher Read|Bash, mirroring SessionStart pipe syntax) or add a second PostToolUse block pointing at the same command; update hook-anti-read-poll.md registration text to match; optionally pin hook-anti-read-poll.sh in hooks.json from the harness so CI catches registration drift.
